  intro m hm

  · rw [Mem.write_same, Mem.write_ne _ _ (by omega), Mem.write_ne _ _ (by addr3)]; exact w2

    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨hq1, _⟩ := w3 q hq
    rw [Mem.write_ne _ _ (by omega), Mem.write_ne _ _ (by omega)]
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
